home_seo_title: Menzies Medora | Calm hospital operations for every care team
home_seo_description: Medora is multi-hospital EMR for registration, visits, clinical work, inventory, and administration. One Soft Wash console for owners, staff, and care floors.
home_hero_headline: Turn hospital days into a calm, connected flow
home_hero_body: Medora: multi-hospital care operations with registration, visits, clinical workbenches, and inventory in one tenant console.
home_how_heading: From registration to a closed visit
home_how_lead: One flow for walk-ins and booked care. Built for the moments teams actually move patients.
home_how_step1_body: Capture identity, allergies, and history once. Every later visit reuses the same chart.
home_how_step2_body: Create OP or IP visits, attach appointments, and keep branch context clear for the floor.
home_how_step3_body: Nursing vitals, diagnoses, medication orders, and documents live on the same visit timeline.
home_how_step4_body: Inventory issues, billing handoffs, and discharge steps stay linked to the visit record.
home_modules_heading: Built for the whole hospital day
home_modules_lead: Capability packs cover the desks that must stay in sync: front office, clinical floors, stores, and admin.
home_modules_registration_body: Patient master, visit creation, appointments, and branch-aware check-in.
home_modules_clinical_body: Nursing and consultation modules with vitals, diagnoses, orders, and EMR notes.
home_modules_inventory_body: Stores, batches, PR/PO/GRN, department consumption, and stock alerts.
home_modules_admin_body: Staff, branches, user groups, masters, documents, and hospital setup.
home_model_heading: One SaaS. Many hospitals. Clear roles.
home_model_lead: Medora is multi-hospital by design. The platform creates the hospital. The hospital runs care. Patients never need your back office.
home_model_platform_body: System admins seed owners, hospitals, and the guardrails every tenant shares.
home_model_hospital_body: Owners and managers configure branches, stores, staff access, and masters.
home_model_staff_body: Nurses, doctors, and store teams work from role-aware modules on the floor.
home_model_patients_body: Charts, visits, and documents stay with the hospital; staff serve from the console.
home_surfaces_heading: Surfaces for every role on the floor
home_surfaces_nursing_body: Vitals, allergies, nursing notes, and bedside tasks without leaving the visit.
home_surfaces_consult_body: Diagnoses, medication orders, and clinical documentation for the doctor desk.
home_surfaces_inventory_body: Receive, issue, transfer, and audit stock with batch and expiry awareness.
home_surfaces_admin_body: Staff, branches, access groups, document masters, and configuration.
home_integrated_heading: Keep every desk on one timeline
home_integrated_lead: Appointments, medication, documents, and stock movements share the visit so the floor stays aligned.
home_cta_heading: Ready to open the next hospital day
home_cta_body: Sign in to the Medora console, choose a hospital, and start from the modules your team already uses.
home_footer_tagline: Hospital operations for registration, clinical care, inventory, and administration.
home_footer_copyright: © {year} Menzies Medora. Care software by Menzies.
home_scene_aria: Soft Wash illustration of a hospital beside trees in a calm courtyard
pricing_seo_title: Menzies Medora pricing | Cloud and On-premise
pricing_seo_description: Medora hospital EMR pricing: Cloud from $99/mo (Starter to Platform). On-premise uses the same tiers at Cloud price + $150/mo for install on your infrastructure. Registration, clinical, inventory, and admin.
pricing_lead: Cloud SaaS or On-premise on your infrastructure. Same Starter, Business, Scale, and Platform tiers. Sized for hospitals and modules, not per-visit meter anxiety.
pricing_lead_cloud: Cloud is hosted Soft Wash Medora: multi-hospital SaaS, managed updates, and shared infrastructure for every site you run.
pricing_lead_onprem: On-premise is the same product tiers, installed and set up on your servers, database, and network. You own the infrastructure. Monthly list is Cloud + ${premium} for that responsibility.
pricing_lead_mmk: Showing MMK at 1 USD = {rate} MMK for local comparison.
pricing_lead_usd: USD list prices for global teams.
pricing_plan_starter_tagline: One hospital on hosted Soft Wash Medora.
pricing_plan_starter_tagline_onprem: One hospital Soft Wash Medora on your infrastructure.
pricing_plan_starter_f6: Email support and continuous Cloud updates
pricing_plan_starter_f6_onprem: Email support; updates on your release path
pricing_plan_business_tagline: Full hospital stack for growing care teams.
pricing_plan_business_tagline_onprem: Full hospital stack installed on your infra.
pricing_plan_business_f1: Up to 3 hospitals on hosted SaaS
pricing_plan_business_f1_onprem: Up to 3 hospitals on your infrastructure
pricing_plan_business_f2: Branches, user groups, and document masters
pricing_plan_business_f4: PR / PO / GRN and stock alerts
pricing_plan_scale_tagline_onprem: Multi-hospital ops on your infra with integrations.
pricing_plan_platform_tagline_onprem: Operators running many hospitals on your infra.
pricing_plan_platform_f6: Volume messaging and data residency options
pricing_plan_platform_f6_onprem: Volume messaging and hardened residency on your network
pricing_who_heading: Mapped to the Medora care model
pricing_who_lead: Platform, hospital, staff, and patients each get a clear lane. Pick Cloud or On-premise, then the same tier that matches how many hospitals and modules you run.
pricing_who_platform_body: Operators who seed many hospitals and need white-label plus SSO. Choose Platform on Cloud or On-premise.
pricing_who_hospital_body: Owners and managers configuring branches, stores, staff access, and masters. Business or Scale fits most multi-site groups.
pricing_who_staff_body: Nurses, doctors, and store teams on role-aware modules. Seat limits scale with the plan; patients never see the back office.
pricing_who_patients_body: Charts, visits, and documents stay with the hospital. Staff serve from the console across registration through close.
pricing_faq_q1: Is pricing per visit or per staff seat?
pricing_faq_a1: Published tiers are per hospital group with hospital and seat caps. Cloud and On-premise share Starter, Business, Scale, and Platform. On-premise monthly list is Cloud + $150. Neither mode uses a per-visit meter that spikes on busy days.
pricing_faq_a2: Annual billing locks in a predictable year of Soft Wash Medora. Loomline-style hospital SaaS often discounts yearly plans about 15 to 20%. Medora applies 20% off the monthly list when you pay yearly, for both Cloud and On-premise (after the +$150 On-premise premium).
pricing_faq_q3: Are inventory and clinical modules included?
pricing_faq_a3: Starter includes core registration, visits, and clinical workbenches with basic inventory. Business and above unlock full inventory workflows, medication orders linked to stock, and richer admin configuration. Ask when you need regulated add-ons.
pricing_faq_a4: Use the market toggle above the plans. Global shows USD only. Myanmar shows MMK at 1 USD = 5000 MMK (with USD as a secondary line). Billing period and service mode are separate from market.
pricing_faq_a5: Cloud is hosted Soft Wash Medora: multi-hospital SaaS, managed updates, and faster start. On-premise uses the same tiers, installed on your infrastructure when you need control or residency. Infra is yours; monthly list is Cloud + $150 for that responsibility.
